name: Retail Deposits
description: Consumer checking, savings, money market, and certificate-of-deposit balances, pricing, and account dynamics.

metrics.name: deposit_balance
metrics.description: Deposit balance at a point in time

metrics.name: net_new_deposits
metrics.description: Inflows minus outflows over the period

metrics.name: deposit_rate
metrics.description: Weighted average rate paid on interest-bearing deposits

metrics.name: deposit_beta
metrics.description: Change in deposit rate divided by change in the policy rate over the same cycle

metrics.name: account_count
metrics.description: Open accounts at a point in time

metrics.name: attrition_rate
metrics.description: Accounts closed in the period divided by opening accounts

conventions.rule: State whether a balance is period-end or period-average; never sum balances across periods.
A deposit beta is measured over a stated rate cycle using the same start and end dates for the deposit rate and the policy rate.
Keep interest-bearing and noninterest-bearing balances distinguishable; the rate paid applies to interest-bearing balances only.

insight_rules.reason: A beta is a ratio of changes; it cannot be decomposed into additive contributions.

caveats.text: Period-end balances can swing on the last day (payroll, tax dates, window dressing); compare period averages before drawing conclusions.

chart_conventions.rule: Plot balances as a line over time and label whether the series is period-end or average.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
